description: Required. The coded procedure, a CURIE from ProcedureConceptEnum (OMOP SNOMED codes). Use the CURIE in the Procedure Concepts table for the concept being harmonized: OMOP:4184832 coronary angioplasty, OMOP:4336464 coronary artery bypass graft, OMOP:45772840 implantable cardiac pacemaker. Set it on every record, whether the status is PRESENT, ABSENT or UNKNOWN, because the slot is required and procedure_status carries the answer. ProcedureConceptEnum also holds OMOP:1242799 operation on carotid artery, OMOP:4044550 dilation - action, OMOP:4178405 revascularization - action and OMOP:4223020 cardiac catheterization; those are different procedures and need their own concept rows before use.
Example source variable description: Q37. History of coronary angioplasty prior to event [Hospital Abstraction Form. HRA. Version F]|Q54a. F. Invasive procedures. Ever had angioplasty of coronary arteries? [Visit 1] [Medical History Form, MHX]|Q36. History of coronary bypass surgery prior to event [Hospital Abstraction Form. HRA. Version F]|Do you have a cardiac pacemaker? Q9 [Dental Screening Form, DSRA04. Visit 4]

description: Required. Whether the procedure (or the pacemaker) is present, absent or unknown for the participant at the time of the report, from StatusEnum. This is the Yes/No/Do not know answer to a history question. Procedure uses StatusEnum only (PRESENT, ABSENT, UNKNOWN); there is no HISTORICAL value on Procedure, because a procedure that was done is simply PRESENT.

The procedure was done, or the pacemaker is in place, as of the report. Source values such as Y, Yes, 1 or a checked box map here. Exception: a composite item (MRI screening 'cardiac pacemaker or a heart valve prosthesis') does not show a pacemaker; see the Pacemaker implant status concept.
Example source variable description: Q54a. F. Invasive procedures. Ever had angioplasty of coronary arteries? [Visit 1] [Medical History Form, MHX]|CORONARY BYPASS AT ANY TIME IN THE PAST?|Do you have a cardiac pacemaker? Q9 [Dental Screening Form, DSRA04. Visit 4]

description: The participant reports or the record shows the procedure was not done, or there is no pacemaker. Source values such as N, No or 0 map here.
Example source variable description: Q45a. E. Invasive procedures. Did you have coronary bypass? [Visit 9] [Medical History Form, MHX]

description: The answer is not known: do not know, refused, missing, uncertain or an unreadable code. Production maps values such as U, T (uncertain), K, R, M, A, 8 and 9 here. Do not use ABSENT for a missing answer.

Required. Where the Procedure record came from, one value from ProvenanceEnum. Read it from the form named in the source variable description. The same concept can come from several sources in one study (for example ARIC pacemaker: participant questionnaire, hospital abstraction, screening form), so set it per source table, not per concept. Use HEALTH_RECORD (not HOSPITAL_RECORD, which is not a BDC-HM value). The enum holds the names below; do not enter a bare OMOP CURIE.
The participant told the study about the procedure or device in an interview or questionnaire. The most common value for these concepts.
Example source variable description: [Invasive procedures]. Did you have: angioplasty of the coronary arteries: Q7a [Health/Medical History, HHXD04. Visit 4]|Q54a. F. Invasive procedures. Ever had angioplasty of coronary arteries? [Visit 1] [Medical History Form, MHX]|Do you have a cardiac pacemaker? Q9 [Dental Screening Form, DSRA04. Visit 4]|[Exclusion]. Do you have a cardiac pacemaker or a heart valve prosthesis? Q4 [MRI Screening Form, MSCA04. Visit 3]

description: The participant reported it and said a doctor told them or confirmed it. Valid on HM main; production has not used it for these concepts.
Example source variable description: MD said pt had coronary angioplasty?

description: The procedure was abstracted from a hospital or medical record, for example a hospital abstraction form.
Example source variable description: Q37. History of coronary angioplasty prior to event [Hospital Abstraction Form. HRA. Version F]|Q29c. special procedures/operations during stay: Coronary angioplasty [Hospital Abstraction Form. HRA. Version F]|Q36. History of coronary bypass surgery prior to event [Hospital Abstraction Form. HRA. Version F]|Q51 - Interventions: Coronary Artery Bypass Graft [Heart Failure Hospital Record Abstraction Form, HFA]

description: The procedure came from an electronic health record. Production uses it for the ARIC heart failure hospital record abstraction (pacemaker); the other hospital abstraction forms use HEALTH_RECORD.
Example source variable description: Q50 - Interventions: Biventricular pacemaker (CRT) [Heart Failure Hospital Record Abstraction Form, HFA]

description: The procedure came from a death certificate, autopsy or medical examiner or coroner report.
Example source variable description: HX OF CORONARY ANGIOPLASTY Q20 [Coroner /Medical Examiner Form]|HX OF CORONARY BYPASS Q19 [Coroner /Medical Examiner Form]

description: The procedure or device was recorded on a study examination or case report form rather than asked of the participant, for example a staff-completed screening or exam form; an ECG-derived finding (ECGA277 pacemaker) is STUDY_RECORD, as in the Condition guide.

Use when the record comes from a study-collected record not covered by a more specific value above, including a finding read from a study ECG (ARIC ECGA277 'Major9; Pacemaker', as the Condition guide treats ECG-derived findings).

Optional. The participant age when the procedure was done, an integer number of DAYS (BDC-HM unit d). Convert years with years * 365. Leave empty when the source only asks whether the procedure was ever done. Where the source gives an enrollment age and a day-count to the event, add them (age * 365 + days), as WHI does. Do not fill it with the age at the visit; that age is not the age at the procedure.
Example source variable description: Days enrollment to PTCA|Age at screening

description: Optional. A Quantity object for the number of procedures ordered or done. Not used by the current Procedure concepts; leave empty.

Optional. A BodySite object (an Uberon term in the required site, plus optional laterality in qualifier), not a bare CURIE. The concept already names the vessel or organ, so leave empty for these concepts.
Required. Links the Procedure to the Participant. The participant ID is usually in the same table as the procedure variable.
Example source variable description: De-identified ARIC subject ID|SHARE ID NUMBER|WHI dbGaP Subject ID

description: Optional. Links the Procedure to the Visit or exam where it was asked or recorded. For a history question, the visit is when the question was asked, not when the procedure happened.
